title: Philip Glass - Etude No. 6
arrangement: v5, Yuja Wang form (180 bars), dynamics/tempo/pedal from her recording. See ARRANGEMENT.md.

grid.note: 8-bar harmonic cycles (~7 s each) start at bars 5, 13, 21 ... 5+8k. Cut on these lines.

sections.note: Octave-hit cycles are the loud, dramatic material; everything else sits between p and mf. Bars 1-4 are the left-hand intro.

rights: Philip Glass, Etude No. 6 is under copyright. These MIDI files are committed at Stephen's request; don't redistribute beyond this repo.
